title: ML coding
description: ML coding interview practice in Python and NumPy, no GPU needed: classic models, data preparation and metrics, language-model mechanics, GenAI building blocks and the control loop around agents. The LLM gym has batched GPU versions of several of them, with a benchmark.

sources.title: AIMLInterviews (Alireza Dirafzoon, MIT)
sources.note: The interview guide whose ML coding catalog sets this gym's topics.

sources.title: AIMLInterviews: ML coding catalog
sources.note: The topic list. Statements, tests and solutions here were written for this gym.

tracks.name: Classic ML: models
tracks.summary: The models an ML coding round asks for, written from the math: regression, classification, clustering, trees and a small network.

tracks.name: Classic ML: data and evaluation
tracks.summary: Metrics, sampling, splits and preprocessing, done without leaking test data into training.

tracks.name: Language models
tracks.summary: The pieces between text and a next-token distribution: tokenization, attention, masks, positions and sampling.

tracks.name: Generative AI
tracks.summary: Building blocks of modern generative systems: low-rank adapters, contrastive and preference losses, retrieval and guidance.

tracks.name: Agentic AI
tracks.summary: The control loop around a model that calls tools: validating, retrying, planning and remembering, all bounded.
